## Checklist

- [ ] One change only; refactors split out
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and they fail without the change
- [ ] Docs updated if build, test, or run steps changed
- [ ] No secrets and no unrelated diffs
- [ ] Drawings changed? Release checklist done and register updated.
  See `templates/drawing/drawing-release-checklist.md` and
  `templates/drawing/title-block-checklist.md`.
